name: Vidreres (Spain)
description: Black field with a yellow cross throughout charged with a narrower black cross, and at the centre a yellow square bearing a black open castle.
history: The flag was published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 22 January 1993; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, black, with a yellow cross throughout of arms half the height charged with a black cross of arms 1/6, and at the centre a yellow square of side 2/3 of the height charged with the black open castle of the arms (approved 26 October 1992), which represents the castle of the town, which belonged to the viscounty of Cabrera.
